# Inventor test fixture

`viewport-selection-solid.ipt` is the generated portable fixture from the
MCAD-Scenarios viewport entity selection feature. It contains a rectangular
solid and two populated 3D sketches. Its SHA-256 is
`ca89533b3cecbf0650c34b8aad8d2b32f595bc0dac6b363ca487e101f70500ac`.

The test uses the file to check decoded sketch names, coordinates, and endpoint
references. It does not treat decoding as proof that the document host can open
or save Inventor files.
